item.title: Fracking in the Kimberley
item.description: The state’s independent environmental authority has approved a fracking proposal (called the Valhalla program) to go ahead in the Kimberley, with some conditions. It follows the state government’s lifting of the fracking ban in some parts of WA seven years ago and it has conservation groups concerned. Brad Bowden chats with Martin Pritchard. The post Fracking in the Kimberley appeared first on RTRFM.

item.title: Urban Greening Strategy
item.description: Perth’s urban forest canopy is in a state of critical, ongoing decline, often considered the sparsest, most barren of all the Australian capital cities. The state government via the Department of Planning Lands and Heritage has just released the first Urban Greening Strategy for the Perth and Peel regions. Brad Bowden chats with Sarah Allchurch. The post Urban Greening Strategy appeared first on RTRFM.
